declarations.name: AuiButton

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Busy state: aria-disabled, activation blocked, spinner shown, 'Loading' added to the accessible name.

inputs.name: fullWidth
inputs.description: Stretch to the full inline size of the container.

models.name: pressed
models.description: Toggle button: bind [(pressed)]; unset is an ordinary button.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Button pattern, implemented with a native <button>.

limitations: Loading state blocks activation through a capture-phase click listener; consumer listeners added with capture on the same element before enhancement still run.
Icon-only buttons without text require `label`, aria-label or aria-labelledby; otherwise construction throws BUTTON_ICON_ONLY_LABEL.

declarations.name: AuiLinkButton
declarations.description: A link styled as a button: `Help` or, with the router, `Reports` (import `RouterLink` from `@angular/router`). The element stays a link: href, `target`, `rel`, `download`, modified clicks (new tab), `routerLinkActive`, query params, and fragments keep working natively. `disabled` sets `aria-disabled`, removes the link from the tab order, and blocks activation (including `RouterLink` navigation) while keeping the href; `loading` blocks activation too.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Busy state: aria-disabled, activation blocked, spinner shown, 'Loading' added to the accessible name.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Links have no native `disabled`: `aria-disabled`, out of the tab order, activation blocked.

inputs.name: fullWidth
inputs.description: Stretch to the full inline size of the container.
